title: Create success toast wording
expected: Success toast 'Role created successfully.' (green check_circle, Close action)
actual: Created a custom role (name 'ZZAUTOTEST QA <ts>', 6 permissions) via Create Custom Role > Skip template > Create. A success toast reading exactly 'Role created successfully.' appeared and the app navigated back to the Roles & Permissions list.
reason: Toast wording matches spec exactly: 'Role created successfully.'

title: Permission validation error — required Role name missing on Create
expected: Form submission is blocked. Validation error appears.
actual: On Create Role page with Role Name blank, the Create button is disabled (submission blocked). Touching then clearing the Role Name field surfaces an inline validation error 'Role name is a required field'. URL stays on /roles-permissions/new (no submission).
reason: Matches: submission is blocked (Create disabled) and a validation error 'Role name is a required field' appears.

title: Duplicate role name on Create — error copy matches spec
actual: Create Role, entered existing custom role name 'Cust0m' (with a unique permission set to avoid the identical-permissions prompt), clicked Create. A warning toast appeared: 'Role name already exists in the Organization. Please try to resolve this.' (Close action). Creation was blocked (stayed on /new; verified via API that no second 'Cust0m' role was created).
reason: Matches: duplicate name blocks creation and shows an error. Copy: 'Role name already exists in the Organization. Please try to resolve this.'

title: Update success toast wording
expected: Success toast 'Role updated successfully.' (green check_circle, Close action) after confirming in Confirm Permission Updates dialog
actual: Edited the ZZAUTOTEST custom role, turned on the 'View History Logs' permission, clicked Save. A 'Confirm Permission Updates' dialog appeared ('Review the changes below before confirming...', Added permissions: View History Logs, Cancel/Confirm). Clicked Confirm -> success toast 'Role updated successfully.' appeared and app returned to the roles list.
reason: Toast wording matches spec exactly: 'Role updated successfully.' after confirming the Confirm Permission Updates dialog.

title: See Financial Data toggle ON — confirmation modal copy matches spec
expected: On turning See Financial Data ON, a modal opens warning about granting financial data access
actual: In Edit Role > Cross-Cutting Toggles, clicked the 'See Financial Data' toggle (OFF->ON). The toggle flipped to ON immediately with NO confirmation/warning modal shown. The financial-access warning modal described in the case does not appear on toggle.
reason: Behavior deviates from expected: no confirmation modal appears when enabling See Financial Data — the toggle enables directly. Likely a stale case (the on-toggle warning modal was removed) or a regression; the granting of financial access is only summarized later in the generic 'Confirm Permission Updates' dialog on Save, not a dedicated warning modal on toggle. Not logged as pass.

title: Custom role delete (0 users) — confirmation modal copy matches spec
expected: Modal opens (delete confirmation for a 0-user custom role)
actual: On the Roles list, opened the three-dot menu on a 0-user custom role (ZZAUTOTEST, Users=0) and clicked Delete. A confirmation modal opened. Title: 'Confirmation'. Body: 'Are you sure you want to delete this role? This action cannot be undone.' Buttons: 'Cancel' and 'Delete' (primary).
reason: Matches: a delete confirmation modal opens for a 0-user custom role with clear confirm copy and Cancel/Delete actions.

title: Custom role delete (with assigned users) — block modal copy matches spec
expected: A blocking modal appears (NOT a regular delete confirmation); user cannot proceed to delete
actual: For a custom role WITH assigned users (A2 - Custom, Users=1), the Roles-list three-dot menu offers ONLY 'View Permissions' — there is NO Delete option at all. Additionally, on that role's Edit page the 'Delete Role' button is disabled. So deletion is prevented, but no blocking modal is shown.
reason: stale case — behavior OK: the protective behavior (a role with assigned users cannot be deleted) IS enforced, but the mechanism differs from the case — instead of a blocking modal, the Delete action is omitted from the three-dot menu and the edit-page Delete Role button is disabled. No blocking modal appears, so the specified copy cannot be verified. Not logged as pass.

title: Staff role reassign shows no success toast (row updates; billing note in modal)
expected: Step 1: Edit Staff Member modal shows Role select with inline orange note 'Role changes may impact billing.'; Step 2: Save & Close closes modal, row reflects new role, NO success toast
actual: Opened Edit Staff Member for the throwaway Tech (verified email tech@shopview.com). Modal showed the Role select with the inline orange note exactly 'Role changes may impact billing.'. Changed Role from Time Clock to Technician and clicked Save & Close: the modal closed and NO toast was emitted (unlike role Create/Update which show 'Role created/updated successfully.'). Tech restored to Time Clock afterward.
reason: Matches both parts: the orange billing note 'Role changes may impact billing.' is present under the Role select, and the reassign Save & Close path emits no success toast while closing the modal and updating the row.
